content:
nina: Heads up — ACME's PO is stuck in the marketplace pipeline. Procurement says the PO payload is missing the merchant consent flag and it's being rejected by the partner portal. Customer is waiting for a go-live tomorrow.

raj: can you paste the PO id? also which marketplace (aws/gcp/azure)?

nina: PO id 2024-ACM-5587, marketplace=gcp. The portal returns a 422 with `merchant_consent_required`. Here's the portion of the XML they reject:
```xml
<PurchaseOrder>
  <Id>2024-ACM-5587</Id>
  <VendorId>acme-001</VendorId>
  <!-- missing merchantConsent element -->
</PurchaseOrder>
```

procurement-bot: SYSTEM: PO 2024-ACM-5587 rejected by GCP Marketplace API - error=merchant_consent_required (doc: https://partners.gcp.market/docs/po).

mike: quick legal note — we added an extra consent clause in the amended MSA last month for ACME. If the partner portal expects explicit consent flag in the PO, we need either the checkbox in the PO or an attached signed consent doc.

alex-se: two options: 1) resend PO with `merchantConsent=true` field included (if partner portal accepts that param), or 2) upload the signed consent PDF to partner ops and request manual acceptance. I can try option 1 if we can get the exact schema param from partner docs.

laura: tagging @jenna-partnerops — can Partner Ops do a manual accept while we fix the PO payload? This is revenue-blocking for tomorrow's launch. :alarm_clock:

jenna-partnerops: we can do manual acceptance but need the signed consent PDF + the email that confirms the ACME signer. ETA ~24 hours once we have the doc. If you want faster: send a corrected PO with `merchantConsent` and include `consentDocumentUrl` in the payload.

nina: attaching signed consent PDF here: https://files.redwood.internal/acme/signed_consent_2024-03-15.pdf. I'm going to try resend with `merchantConsent=true` and `consentDocumentUrl`. Will update in 15m.

raj: thanks. if manual accept happens, can we get a one-line note for bookkeeping (which legal clause covers it) so finance can map to the purchase code?

mike: Legal will add short rationale: "consent for marketplace listing per MSA section 4.3" and paste it here after acceptance.

nina: update — resent PO with merchantConsent flag and consentDocumentUrl. Initial API response: 202 Accepted. If it stays green I'll close the ticket. :crossed_fingers:
